title: Pulse Cycle
statementMarkdown:
A pulse emitter repeats $7^{n}$ on cycle $n$, but consoles only ever read the **final digit** of the readout.

**What final digit does cycle $n = 2026$ display?**
hints: Compute $7^n$ mod 10 for $n = 1, 2, 3, 4$ — a short repeating loop appears.
Divide 2026 by the loop length and take the remainder.
